name: Memory Kernel
description: Structured memory with typed atoms, relations, spreading activation, and event sourcing.

memoryDir.description: Absolute path to the memory-kernel directory

oneOf.description: AES-256-GCM key for SECRET atom encryption (literal)

id.description: JSON pointer (slash-delimited object keys; arrays and RFC 6901 escapes not supported)

encryptionKey.description: AES-256-GCM key for SECRET atom encryption. Accepts a string or a file SecretRef.

agentId.description: Agent label written to the audit trail

id.description: JSON pointer (slash-delimited object keys; arrays and RFC 6901 escapes not supported)

embeddingApiKey.description: API key for embedding provider. Accepts a string or a file SecretRef. Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY env when provider is openai and this is unset.

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model ID (e.g. "text-embedding-3-small"). Provider default if omitted.

isolationMode.description: Per-agent isolation mode. "auto" reads config.yaml (default), "shared-only" forces flat mode, "per-agent-required" fails if not isolated.

autoInitAgentStore.description: Auto-create agent store on first use if missing. Default: false.

sharedRecall.description: Include shared namespace atoms in isolated recall. Default: true.

failIfMissingAgentStore.description: Deprecated — throwing is now the default behavior when agent store is missing. Retained for backward compatibility. Setting to false maps to allowSharedFallback: true.

allowSharedFallback.description: Allow silent fallback to shared mode when agent store is missing in isolated mode. Default: false (errors instead). Use only during migration or development.

secretProviders.description: Map of alias → file provider used to resolve SecretRefs for encryptionKey/embeddingApiKey. Plugin-local; does not interact with OpenClaw core SecretRef resolution.

path.description: Absolute path (or ~-prefixed) to a JSON file
